prompt: The two people in the provided photos, faces and hair only, at their own wedding reception; a new picture. A cheap disposable-camera snapshot with hard on-camera flash in a pub function room: the room behind falls away to black. Centred, she in a simple cream dress and he in a loosened tie press cheek to cheek, both mid-laugh, eyes creased, a half pint and a paper plate of sausage rolls on the table in front. Slightly blown-out skin, flat flash shadows, warm cheap-print colour. Nothing written anywhere, no date stamp.
